fullDescription: Home dashboard view for the default state of the application hub. It renders a three-column layout with a left repository sidebar, central assistant composer and repository feed, and a right rail for event promotion and changelog updates using the shared GitHubHomeDashboard component.

Presentational dashboard component that supports the github-home-dashboard view in its default state through typed props for user name, repository lists, feed sections, and changelog content. It provides interactive local state for search fields, toolbar selections, and repository action menus while reusing shared button, card, avatar, input, dropdown, and separator primitives.
